Hey, Jo-Ellen. I'm filling out the form for the supply
order for our store. I'm ordering new shelves for our
home improvement section. Do we need anything else?
Let's see... We're running low on plastic shopping
bags. Can you add them to the supply order?
m You know, ®I'm worried that we've been using too
many plastic bags in our store...
Ew I've thought about that. Why don't we offer a
discount to customers who bring their own bags?
That'll be good for the environment, and our store will
save money, too!
